---
title: "Reading Responses"
subtitle: "Choose and complete 8 of the 12 options"
---

Each response is ~2 pages, ends with a **Quote of the Day**, and is due **by class time on Canvas**. Grading: **2** Pass · **1** Poor pass · **0** Fail. Term average must reach 2. **Late = not accepted.**

**Two alternative formats per week:** a 4–5 min video, or a curated high-quality image set (60–90 min of searching).

## How to choose your 8

- **Weeks with a practice (2, 3, 5, 7, 10) are richest** — lived experience makes for stronger, easier writing. A good default.
- **Nov 23 (Gratitude)** is self-contained and over the break — easy to bank.
- **Dec 14 offers two in one week** — handy, but it's the heaviest reading week; don't lean on both as your finale.
- **Space them out:** roughly 2–3 in Sep/Oct, 3 in Nov, 2 in Dec. Don't stack six in December.
- You **still must read every week** whether or not you write — unannounced quizzes can happen.

## Drafting in-site

Start a new response from the template:

- Copy `submissions/_response-template.qmd` to `submissions/rr01-dying-and-rising.qmd` (etc.).
- Write, then `quarto render` that file to PDF for Canvas: it's set up with the required formatting.
- Add it to the [Submissions](submissions.qmd) page.

Prefer to write in Word? Just drop the final file in `submissions/` and link it — see Submissions.
